quote: payment shall be made no later than 30 (thirty) days from the date of submission of the Stage Payment Statement by the Contractor to the Authority’s Engineer for certification in accordance with the provisions of Clause 19.4 for an IPC
notes: Payment is due no later than 30 days from submission of the Stage Payment Statement; if the Engineer has not issued the IPC within those 30 days the Authority pays the amount in the statement. The final payment is also due within 30 days (19.9(i)(b)). Late payment carries interest at Bank Rate + 3% a year (19.9(ii)). Other periods that are NOT the answer: advances are paid within 15 days of request (19.2(v), PDF p102); the Engineer verifies the monthly maintenance statement within 15 days (19.7(i), PDF p105); maintenance IPCs are paid quarterly within 30 days (19.7(iv)).

quote: From every payment for Works due to the Contractor in accordance with the provisions of Clause 19.5, the Authority shall deduct 6% (six per cent) thereof as guarantee money for performance of the obligations of the Contractor during the Construction Period (the “Retention Money”) subject to the condition that the maximum amount of Retention Money shall not exceed 5% (five per cent) of the Contract Price.
notes: 6% is deducted from every payment as 'Retention Money', with a maximum of 5% of the Contract Price. The balance is refunded within 15 days of the Completion Certificate. On termination the retention is treated like Performance Security (7.5(iv)). Footnote 10 (PDF p53) says the Authority may omit clause 7.5 and raise the Performance Security from 7.5% to 10% instead.

quote: The Authority shall make an interest-bearing advance payment (the “Advance Payment”) @ “Bank Rate + 3%”, equal to 10 % (ten percent) of the Contract Price, exclusively for mobilisation expenses.
notes: An interest-bearing advance (Bank Rate + 3%) of 10% of the Contract Price for mobilisation, paid in two instalments of 5%; the second is released after a utilisation certificate for the first. A further advance of up to 5% is available against new key equipment (19.2(ii), PDF p101-102). Each instalment needs a bank guarantee for 110% (19.2(iii), p102). Repayment: 15% of each Stage Payment Statement, completed before 80% of the Scheduled Construction Period has passed (19.2(vi), p103). Interest is compounded annually on a reducing balance (p102).

quote: it shall pay Damages to the Authority of a sum calculated at the rate of 0.05% (zero point zero five percent) of the Contract Price for delay of each day reckoned from the date specified in Schedule –J and until such Project Milestone is achieved or the Project Highway is completed;
notes: The Contractor pays 0.05% of the Contract Price for each day of delay, counted from the Schedule-J date, but only if a Project Milestone or the Scheduled Completion Date is missed by more than 30 days. Total damages may not exceed 10% of the Contract Price (10.3(iii), PDF p68). The damages are refunded, without interest, if the Project Highway is completed by the Scheduled Completion Date. NOT counted: damages for late Performance Security (0.01% of Bid Price a day, 7.1(i)(iii), PDF p51), lane re-opening damages (0.1% of the monthly maintenance payment a day, PDF p89), the early-completion bonus of 0.03% a day up to 5% (19.20, PDF p112), and damages the Authority pays.

quote: the amounts payable to the Contractor for Works, shall be adjusted in the IPC issued by the Authority’s Engineer for the increase or decrease in the index cost of inputs for the Works, by the addition or subtraction of the amounts determined by the formulae prescribed in Clause 19.10 (iv).
notes: Index-based price adjustment (formulae using indices for labour, cement, steel, plant, bitumen, fuel and other inputs) applied through the IPC. Elsewhere the Contract Price is stated NOT to change for cost changes except under clauses 19.10 and 19.17 (19.1(iii), PDF p101). Adjustment is due only for stages whose Stage Payment Statement is submitted within 30 days of the Project Milestone (19.11, PDF p109). The component percentages in the table are bracketed placeholders.

quote: Within 30 (thirty) days of receipt of Letter of Acceptance, the selected Bidder shall furnish to the Authority an irrevocable and unconditional guarantee from a Bank in the form set forth in Annex-I of Schedule-G (the “Performance Security”) for an amount equal to 3% (Three percent) of its Bid Price.
notes: An irrevocable bank guarantee for 3% of the Bid Price, within 30 days of the Letter of Acceptance, valid until 60 days after the Defects Liability Period. For some low bids an Additional Performance Security is also required, capped at 3% of the Bid Price. Half may be furnished first and the rest within 30 days of signing (7.1(ii)). Late furnishing attracts damages of 0.01% of Bid Price a day for up to 60 days (7.1(iii)). Footnote 10 (PDF p53) mentions a template alternative of 7.5% to 10%.
